definitions.explanation: Having no limit or end; available in unlimited quantities. Used for resources, energy, knowledge, and other things that seem to never run out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無尽蔵|むじんぞう}だ。
⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無尽蔵|むじんぞう}な⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧だ。
examples.english: Solar energy is an inexhaustible resource.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無尽蔵|むじんぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、すべて⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: The internet has boundless information, but not all of it is accurate.

notes:
USAGE:
{無尽蔵|むじんぞう} is used as a na-adjective ({無尽蔵|むじんぞう}な〜) or as a noun predicate ({無尽蔵|むじんぞう}だ). It has a somewhat literary feel but is used in everyday contexts when emphasizing abundance.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally a Buddhist term meaning an inexhaustible storehouse of virtue or merit. ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {尽|じん} (exhaustion) + {蔵|ぞう} (storehouse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無尽蔵|むじんぞう}な⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧ (inexhaustible resources)
- {無尽蔵|むじんぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧ (boundless stamina)
- {無尽蔵|むじんぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use without limit)
